races.title: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Chase
races.verdict: Making his third start back this season, EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY ran well when second at Punchestown and he can build on that effort to go one better from what remains a handy mark. Heading the list of dangers is Mickey Cohen who arrives on the back of a win over hurdles, while Mistyburn and Knocknagoran Lady could also be in the mix. EVERYSTEP OFTHEWAY (IRE) MICKEY COHEN (IRE) MISTYBURN (IRE)

races.title: Racing TV Club Day Chase (Listed)
races.verdict: MONTY'S STAR gave a good account in a pair of Leopardstown Grade 1s last season before stretched by the trip in the Grand National, so he could be ready to get back to winning ways at this level. He is preferred ahead of Champ Kiely who ran up to his best on last season's return, with Ile Atlantique also considered. MONTY'S STAR (IRE) CHAMP KIELY (IRE) ILE ATLANTIQUE (FR)

races.title: Horse And Jockey 3-Y-O Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: NERIA is a well-bred filly who sets the standard on her French form and, open to improvement for her new top connections, looks the one to beat. Kenough has made the frame in both hurdle starts and, with the potential for better still firmly intact, is feared most. Maxminelli jumped none too fluently on his hurdles debut but is in excellent hands and is entitled to build on that initial experience. NERIA (FR) KENOUGH (FR) MAXMINELLI (IRE)

races.title: Racing Here Again On 3rd December Maiden Hurdle
races.verdict: Plenty of dead wood in this maiden, MOMENT OF GRACE selected to make a winning start for Willie Mullins having gone down narrowly in a French bumper this time last year. Malte de Solzen is another French import who has joined a top yard so he could be the one to provide most resistance, with Werner and Red Seagull another couple worth considering, too. MOMENT OF GRACE (FR) MALTE DE SOLZEN (FR) WERNER (GER)
